steps.en: Install it as a dev dependency
steps.zh: 作为 dev 依赖安装

steps.en: Import the faker instance in your factory file
steps.zh: 在工厂文件里 import faker 实例

steps.en: Compose namespaced generators into your record shape
steps.zh: 用命名空间生成器拼出你的记录形状

steps.en: Draws plausible values from locale datasets via a seedable PRNG
steps.zh: 经可 seed 的伪随机源从 locale 数据集挑值

steps.en: Set a seed when a failing test must replay exactly
steps.zh: 要精确复现失败时设一个 seed

steps.en: Replays the identical value sequence, in browser and Node alike
steps.zh: 精确重放同一取值序列，浏览器与 Node 一致

value.en: Realistic fixtures by the thousand from one factory function — varied by default, byte-identical when you seed
value.zh: 一个工厂函数吐出上千条逼真 fixture——默认多样，seed 之后逐字节复现
